articles.title: Kylian Mbappé apologises after being dropped by Chinese brands for Mao Zedong comment
articles.snippet: Video appears to show Mao Zedong called a ‘dictator’ Dongpeng and Mengniu end deals with player Kylian Mbappé has apologised for his “ill-judged” comment about the former Chinese leader Mao Zedong, which has led to brands in China dropping the Real Madrid forward. In China jokes about Mao, the founding leader of the People’s Republic of China who died in 1976, are considered disrespectful and remain a social taboo. “Our company firmly opposes and has a zero-tolerance policy towards any behaviour that offends national sentiments,” the drinks company Dongpeng said in a statement earlier on Tuesday, adding that “with immediate effect we are terminating all cooperation with Kylian Mbappé”. Conti

articles.title: Lommel herziet belastingen op 2e verblijven en hervormt tegelijk heel toeristisch reglement
articles.snippet: In Lommel plant het stadsbestuur een hervorming van de belastingen op 2e verblijven. De stad trekt de belasting op 2e verblijven in woongebied op naar 1.500 euro per woning. Daarnaast is er voor de jaargasten op campings als De Blauwe Meer en Parelstrand een volledig nieuw, afzonderlijk reglement uitgewerkt. Zij zullen in de toekomst 600 euro per jaar, per standplaats betalen. De nieuwe belastingreglementen liggen vanavond voor op de gemeenteraad.

articles.title: The survival of American democracy depends on taxing billionaires
articles.snippet: It is essential not just to fund the public goods the nation needs, it is indispensable to restore a sense of fairness Money doesn’t buy happiness, we’re told. Even some economists agree. The Nobel Prize-winning economists, Daniel Kahneman and Angus Deaton, once proposed that rising income increased people’s emotional wellbeing only up to a ceiling of about $115,000 in today’s money. They probably hadn’t met many billionaires. The ultra-rich may not pursue happiness in the joyful sense of the word. But they will try every trick in the book to hang on to their stash and woe befall the tax authority that tries to lay a finger on their treasure. Continue reading...

articles.title: Moeder (61) uit Hooglede veroordeeld nadat drugs in haar luiers worden ontdekt bij gevangenisbezoek in Hasselt
articles.snippet: De rechtbank in Hasselt heeft een vrouw van 61 uit West-Vlaanderen veroordeeld tot 14 maanden cel, omdat ze drugs wilde binnensmokkelen in de gevangenis van Hasselt. Ze werd in augustus betrapt toen ze haar volwassen zoon kwam bezoeken. In 2 luiers voor volwassenen die ze droeg, had ze 135 gram hasj en 50 gram cannabis verstopt. Volgens de vrouw werd ze bedreigd door 2 onbekenden, maar wie die mensen zijn, wilde ze niet zeggen.

The lobby group said shop price inflation was 2.1% year on year in October, a sharp rise compared with 1.4% in September, and an indication that retailers were beginning to pass on the rising costs of energy and food ingredients since the Middle East conflict broke out. This is the latest of several trimmings Microsoft has made to its workforce this year. The company announced in April that it was offering voluntary retirement to about 7% of its US workforce, which consisted of about 125,000 employees at the time.
